question: Does weight-for-length condition incrementally rank telemetry-defined migration initiation beyond the continuous eye/fin morphology underlying silvering classification?

sources.population: Same public migration-eligible source as azores analysis/36, but restricted to complete eye/fin measurements
sources.label_rule: keep 9 fixed 2015 expert-classified non-migrants as non-initiators

morphology.identify_by: length2/length3/length4 *_type labels, never by column number
morphology.bounds: All measurements must be positive finite values; report by-project completeness and units.

models.baseline: project-year FE + length centered within project-year + release-date centered within project-year + ordinal Durif stage
models.base_plus_condition: baseline + weight-for-length residual condition from existing entry-state pipeline
models.estimation: Frozen L2 penalized logistic, lambda=1.0 on predictor coefficients only, NOT intercept/project-year dummies; train means/SD for continuous morphology from training projects only
models.heldout: Leave one of the complete-morphology projects out. Do not fit coefficient weights with heldout initiation labels. Project/year intercepts not transferred.
models.models_same_sample: All four models scored on exactly the same complete-morphology eels.

primary: Within heldout project-year positive-negative-pair AUC of full minus base_plus_morphology
secondary: Base-plus-condition vs baseline on the exact same reduced sample
Base-plus-morphology vs baseline on the exact same reduced sample
Full vs base-plus-condition on the exact same reduced sample
Condition incremental contrast after morphology within each FIII/FIV/FV category when support permits
Project and stage counts, leave-one-project-out pooled AUC differences, 10000 project bootstrap replicates

interpretation.positive_supported: Only if full model raises AUC after morphology with a positive project-resampled CI and no single-project dependence. Even then physiological independence is unproven.
interpretation.otherwise: No robust extra ranking once continuous morphology included; could reflect quantization or data limitations, NOT proof of no independent energy mechanism.
constraints: Condition residual uses weight and length; the original Durif classification also uses weight/length and eye/fin morphology. These are not independent physiological measurements.
No direct lipid, endocrine status, hunger or survival is measured.
The Warnow project has no eye or fin measurements; loss of that project's comparison limits transferability and shifts cohort composition.
All analyses were developed after observing previous stage-specific results; classify as exploratory falsification.
Event labels are telemetry-defined initiation, not escapement success or true nonmigration.
